idea-plugin.name: Claudex Autocomplete
idea-plugin.description:
Inline code completion in your editor, using the Claude Code or Codex CLI you already have installed and logged in. Uses your existing subscription login, no API key needed.

Features

  • Inline gray-text suggestions as you type
  • Choose Claude Code or Codex as the provider
  • Accept the whole suggestion, the next word or the rest of the line
  • Context from the current file, open tabs and, for PHP, imported classes
  • Persistent Claude Code process for lower latency
  • Animated spinner with elapsed time while a suggestion is generated
  • Status bar widget with request state and usage windows
  • Custom prompt additions and per-language disable list

Requirements

  • IntelliJ-based IDE 2025.3 or newer
  • Claude Code CLI (claude) or Codex CLI (codex), installed and logged in

Getting started

  1. Log in: run claude and then /login, or run codex login.
  2. Choose Enable in the first-run notification, or turn on Enable completions in Settings | Tools | Claudex Autocomplete, and select the provider.
  3. Start typing. Press Tab to accept, Esc to dismiss, Shift+Alt+\ to trigger manually, or use Tools | Trigger Claudex Autocomplete to force a completion mid-line.

Privacy

The plugin runs your local CLI with your existing subscription login. Code context around the caret, and optionally from open tabs, is sent to Anthropic or OpenAI through that CLI and is subject to their terms. Nothing is sent until you enable completions.

Claudex Autocomplete is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Anthropic or OpenAI. Claude is a trademark of Anthropic; Codex is a trademark of OpenAI.
